title: 第五章 主人快来这个人她好香第六章 加好友没必要
slug: 兽校开局被强吻我被疯批们娇宠
content_zh:
简妤举手的姿势过分乖巧，林教授外露的情绪渐渐收敛。
似乎真的相信了许见娟说的：她室友胆小。
他语气变得格外温和，“那就请胆小的简妤同学站起来，回答一下这个问题吧。”
简妤起身，白皙的手指扶了扶眼镜，小脸严肃，“我不胆小，社恐不是胆小。”
社恐是心理障碍，胆小是性格特质。
不影响举手！
“老师，回答问题前，请允许我澄清一下。我跟许见娟同学不熟，她很少回宿舍。”
想来想去，还是决定说清楚。
免得以后女主觉得她好欺负，逮着她一个人薅。
“我昨晚确实看了一晚上的基因学，对林教授的课很感兴趣。”
简妤真诚地眨眨眼，希望林教授不会迁怒她，影响她申请奖助学金，那可是一百万！
“谢谢许见娟同学的好意，不过下次，我可以自己举手的。”
所以，麻烦你，不要再替我举手了！
回应力度跟奶猫力气一样小，略显窝囊。
许见娟很自然地道歉，不好意思地解释，“对不起，可能是我误会了。”
有人笑了。
冷笑。
小插曲过去，简妤绷着面瘫脸，快速切回正题。
“兽魂的觉醒，是基于血脉基因，那么林教授所提及的兽魂进化，我认为或许也可以从基因入手？”
林教授表情淡淡，“嗯。”

简妤迷茫，她的话让人很失望？
环顾四周。
其他同学没有嘲笑她，但眼睛齐齐回到课本上，没有继续听的意思。
不管了，简妤继续叭叭。
速度跟播音主持似的。实际上，人很慌，手臂板正，手指还紧张地扣了扣裤子。
许见娟比简妤还紧张。
听了一会儿，肉眼可见的着急起来。
因为她余光发现盛越的眼皮抬都没抬，简妤的话，丝毫没引起他的兴趣。
成绩好有什么用，蠢死了。
通宵一晚上，明明书本看到最后一页了，难道她不知道她这个见解，早八百年就有人提出来过吗？
看的什么书？不进脑子的吗？
许见娟黑着脸，她可能找错人了。
content_en:
Jian Yu's gesture of raising her hands was too cute, and Professor Lin's exposed emotions gradually subsided.
It seemed that she really believed what Xu Jianjuan said: her roommate was timid.
His tone became particularly gentle, "Then please ask the timid classmate Jian Yu to stand up and answer this question."
Jian Yu stood up, adjusted her glasses with her fair fingers, and said with a serious face, "I'm not timid, I'm afraid that's not timid."
Social anxiety is a psychological disorder, and timidity is a personality trait.
It doesn’t affect the raising of hands!
"Teacher, before answering the question, please allow me to clarify. I am not familiar with classmate Xu Jianjuan. She rarely returns to the dormitory."
After much deliberation, I decided to make it clear.
In case the heroine thinks she is easy to bully in the future, she will be caught alone.
"I did watch genetics all night last night and was very interested in Professor Lin's class."
Jian Yu blinked sincerely, hoping that Professor Lin would not anger her and affect her application for scholarships and bursaries, which was worth one million!
"Thank you, classmate Xu Jianjuan, for your kindness, but next time, I can raise my hand myself."
So, please, don’t raise your hand for me again!
The strength of the response was as weak as that of a milk cat, which seemed a bit cowardly.
Xu Jianjuan apologized naturally and explained sheepishly, "I'm sorry, maybe I misunderstood."
Someone laughed.
sneer.
After the interlude, Jian Yu quickly returned to the topic with a sullen face.
"The awakening of the beast soul is based on bloodline genes. So the evolution of the beast soul mentioned by Professor Lin, I think maybe we can also start from genes?"
Professor Lin's expression was calm, "Yeah."
Jian Yu was confused. Her words were disappointing?
Look around.
The other students did not laugh at her, but their eyes all returned to the textbook, with no intention of continuing to listen.
Regardless, Jian Yu continued.
The speed is like a broadcast host. In fact, the man was in a panic, his arms were straight, and his fingers were nervously buttoning his pants.
Xu Jianjuan was more nervous than Jian Yu.
After listening for a while, I became visibly anxious.
Because she noticed from the corner of her eye that Sheng Yue didn't even raise his eyelids, Jian Yu's words did not arouse his interest at all.
What's the use of having good grades? You're so stupid.
After staying up all night, she had clearly reached the last page of the book. Didn't she know that someone had proposed her opinion eight hundred years earlier?
What book are you reading? Doesn't it come into your head?
Xu Jianjuan's face turned dark. She might have found the wrong person.
